findings.summary: The lifecycle maintains selectedDictionary as reactive public state with no production consumer.
findings.consequence: Transitions mutate and expose additional state although telemetry consumes selection directly and no production caller reads the ref.
findings.evidence: The ref is declared, assigned, reset, and returned; only lifecycle tests read it.
findings.recommendation: Remove the ref and return member, retaining the local selection argument for telemetry.
verification: Searched all references and inspected production consumers and telemetry call.

findings.summary: The loopback-host allowlist is duplicated across parent and embed-origin validation.
findings.consequence: The lists could drift and make local HTTP support asymmetric.
findings.evidence: The composable and reader-dictionary-embed.ts independently declare the same localhost, IPv4 loopback, and IPv6 loopback set.
findings.recommendation: Own and reuse the loopback-host predicate in reader-dictionary-embed.ts while retaining the requirement that both parent and target are loopback.
verification: Compared both policies and inspected local/production tests.
